plan.notes: Transcribed from the official CRC 'Nutrition and Dietetics AS-T Degree' program map, Catalog Year 2026-2027, published September 23, 2026 (mapmaker.losrios.edu/Maps/8046/PublishedPdf). GE Pattern: Cal-GETC. Map states Total Units 61-62; lower bound 61 encoded = 15+14+15+17 (semester sums verified at lower bound: Sem 2 statistics choice STAT C1000E (4)/ECON 310 (3)/PSYC 330 (3) -> 3). STATISTICS CHOICE: STAT C1000E Introduction to Statistics (4 units), ECON 310 Statistics for Business and Economics (3 units), or PSYC 330 Introductory Statistics for the Behavioral Sciences (3 units); all require Intermediate Algebra or the high school equivalent (placement; documented here, not encoded). Lower bound 3 encoded. CHEM 400 pre-req per map: CHEM 300, 305, or 309 or 1 year of high school chemistry with lab (entry chemistry placement; documented here, not encoded). BIOL 440 pre-req per map: CHEM 305, 309, or 400; encoded as one_of (CHEM 305/309 carried under external_prereqs). Advisory (recommended, not required): PSYC C1000 advisory ENGL C1000, ENGL C1000H, or ESLW 340; and LIBR 318. CalGETC Area 4 footnote: a total of 6 units from 2 disciplines is required (PSYC C1000 in Semester 2 and one Area 4 course in Semester 4). Transferable electives: units needed to total 60 for graduation; refer to Course Number for the appropriate course level. CalGETC Area 1A: map recommends meeting with a counselor.
